done_when: Every Codex thread Forge starts (worker, plan reader, ask and review) is given model_verbosity = low, model_reasoning_summary = none, and a developer instruction to write no progress commentary, only the final handoff and any question, in its thread config, whatever the repo's or the user's Codex config says; a repo's forge.toml can't turn them back up. New and existing repos: every repo gets it from the new release, with no setting to change. One command-level test: the thread start and resume requests a worker and a review send carry those settings.
why: Codex worker, reader and review threads stream progress commentary and reasoning summaries nobody reads, wasting tokens; Forge only passes model and effort, so quietness depends on each repo's project config and each developer's own Codex settings
